# Read pill clearance (#250)

Open this note in the editor and walk down with the arrow keys, or type at
the bottom of the window. The caret line must always stay above the
**Read · Ctrl+Shift+E** pill in the bottom-left corner. Scrolled to its end,
the last line rises above the pill too. In the reading view (Read or
Ctrl+Shift+E), zoom out with Ctrl+wheel: the last line still clears the
**Edit · Esc** pill.

| Where | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| Editor, caret on the bottom row | Line scrolls above the pill |
| Editor, scrolled to the end | Last line above the pill |
| Reading view at 50 % zoom | Last line above the pill |
